mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE inspection_scan_seed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN own.organization_type = 'TEAM' AND own.parent_id IS NOT NULL THEN own.parent_id ELSE own.id END AS id FROM system_user scoped_user JOIN organization own ON own.tenant_id = scoped_user.tenant_id AND own.id = scoped_user.organization_id AND own.status = 1 AND own.deleted = 0 WHERE scoped_user.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scoped_user.id = #{userId} AND scoped_user.status = 1 AND scoped_user.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT CASE WHEN membership_team.organization_type = 'TEAM' AND membership_team.parent_id IS NOT NULL THEN membership_team.parent_id ELSE membership_team.id END AS id FROM system_user_team_membership membership JOIN organization membership_team ON membership_team.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND membership_team.id = membership.team_organization_id AND membership_team.status = 1 AND membership_team.deleted = 0 WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.user_id = #{userId} AND membership.deleted = 0 ), inspection_scan_roots AS ( SELECT organization_row.id FROM organization organization_row JOIN inspection_scan_seed seed ON seed.id = organization_row.id WHERE organization_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_row.status = 1 AND organization_row.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM organization child JOIN inspection_scan_roots parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status = 1 AND child.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT id FROM inspection_scan_roots
SELECT mobile_enabled FROM system_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(parameter_value AS SIGNED) FROM system_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parameter_key = #{parameterKey} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT parameter_value FROM system_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parameter_key = #{parameterKey} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'RUNNING'), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'STOPPED'), 0) AS stopped, 0 AS fault, 0 AS offline, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'IDLE'), 0) AS idle, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'SCRAPPED'), 0) AS scrapped FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.status = 1 AND e.deleted = 0 AND

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED'), 0) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.severity = 'CRITICAL'), 0) AS critical, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.severity = 'HIGH'), 0) AS high FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal JOIN inspection_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND abnormal.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.task_code, task.scheme_version_id, task.scheme_name_snapshot AS scheme_name, task.task_status, task.source_type, submitter.real_name AS executor_name, task.submitted_time, task.completed_time FROM inspection_task task LEFT JOIN system_user submitter ON submitter.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND submitter.id = task.submitted_by AND submitter.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.task_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND ( task.planned_date = CURRENT_DATE() OR (task.completed_time >= CURRENT_DATE() AND task.completed_time < DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(task.completed_time, task.submitted_time, task.created_time) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT message_type, severity, title, content, occurred_time, route_path FROM ( SELECT 'INSPECTION_OVERDUE' AS message_type, 'HIGH' AS severity, CONCAT('点检任务逾期：', task.task_code) AS title, CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · 截止 ', DATE_FORMAT(task.due_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS content, COALESCE(task.updated_time, task.due_time) AS occurred_time, CONCAT('/mobile/inspection?taskId=', task.id) AS route_path FROM inspection_task task JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND e.id = task.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND ( task.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR ( task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'MAINTENANCE_OVERDUE', 'HIGH', CONCAT('维保任务逾期：', task.task_code), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · 截止 ', DATE_FORMAT(task.due_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')), COALESCE(task.updated_time, task.due_time), CONCAT('/mobile/maintenance?taskId=', task.id) FROM maintenance_task task JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND e.id = task.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND collaborator.task_id = task.id AND collaborator.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND ( task.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR ( task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'INSPECTION_ABNORMAL', abnormal.severity, CONCAT('点检异常：', abnormal.abnormal_title), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · ', abnormal.abnormal_description), abnormal.created_time, '/mobile/messages' FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal JOIN inspection_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND e.id = abnormal.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0 AND ( abnormal.responsible_user_id = #{userId} OR task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'MAINTENANCE_ABNORMAL', abnormal.severity, CONCAT('维保异常：', abnormal.abnormal_title), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · ', abnormal.abnormal_description), abnormal.created_time, '/mobile/messages' FROM maintenance_abnormal abnormal JOIN maintenance_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND e.id = abnormal.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0 ) message ORDER BY occurred_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, category.category_name, e.model, e.specification, e.brand, e.manufacturer, e.factory_serial_number, e.production_date, e.commissioning_date, organization.organization_name, location.location_name, e.asset_number, e.lifecycle_stage, e.critical_flag, e.special_flag, e.oee_enabled, e.description, COALESCE(current_status.status_code, 'IDLE') AS status_code, COALESCE(palette.status_name, '空闲') AS status_name, COALESCE(palette.display_color, '#64748b') AS status_color, current_status.status_since, responsible.real_name AS responsible_name, e.updated_time FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND e.id = barcode.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND category.id = e.category_id AND category.deleted = 0 JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN location ON location.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND location.id = e.location_id AND location.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN visualization_status_color palette ON palette.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND palette.status_code = COALESCE(current_status.status_code, 'IDLE') AND palette.status = 1 AND palette.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_user responsible ON responsible.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND responsible.id = e.primary_responsible_user_id AND responsible.deleted = 0 WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND barcode.access_token = #{token} AND barcode.active_slot = 1 AND LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, e.organization_id, organization.organization_name, e.status AS equipment_status, organization.status AS organization_status, CASE WHEN e.deleted = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS equipment_deleted, CASE WHEN organization.deleted = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS organization_deleted, CASE WHEN barcode.active_slot = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS barcode_active FROM equipment_barcode barcode LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND e.id = barcode.equipment_id LEFT JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND barcode.access_token = #{token} ORDER BY barcode.active_slot DESC, barcode.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT task_id, task_code, workflow_type, scheme_name, task_status, due_time, route_path FROM ( SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.task_code, 'INSPECTION' AS workflow_type, task.scheme_name_snapshot AS scheme_name, task.task_status, task.due_time, CONCAT('/mobile/inspection?taskId=', task.id) AS route_path FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) UNION ALL SELECT task.id, task.task_code, 'MAINTENANCE', task.scheme_name_snapshot, task.task_status, task.due_time, CONCAT('/mobile/maintenance?taskId=', task.id) FROM maintenance_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND collaborator.task_id = task.id AND collaborator.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ) active ORDER BY due_time, task_id LIMIT 20

WITH RECURSIVE applicable_categories AS ( SELECT relation.scheme_version_id, category.id, relation.include_descendants_flag FROM inspection_scheme_category relation JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND category.id = relation.equipment_category_id AND category.status = 1 AND category.deleted = 0 WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.scheme_version_id, child.id, parent.include_descendants_flag FROM equipment_category child JOIN applicable_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id AND parent.include_descendants_flag = 1 WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status = 1 AND child.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT scheme.id AS scheme_id, version.id AS scheme_version_id, scheme.scheme_code, scheme.scheme_name, scheme.inspection_type, version.backfill_allowed_flag AS backfill_allowed FROM equipment e JOIN inspection_scheme scheme ON scheme.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND scheme.status = 1 AND scheme.deleted = 0 JOIN inspection_scheme_version version ON version.tenant_id = scheme.tenant_id AND version.id = scheme.current_version_id AND version.version_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND version.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND (version.expiry_date IS NULL OR version.expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE()) WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{equipmentId} AND e.status = 1 AND e.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_scheme_equipment relation WHERE relation.tenant_id = version.tenant_id AND relation.scheme_version_id = version.id AND relation.equipment_id = e.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applicable_categories category_scope WHERE category_scope.scheme_version_id = version.id AND category_scope.id = e.category_id ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_scheme matched_scheme JOIN inspection_scheme_version matched_version ON matched_version.tenant_id = matched_scheme.tenant_id AND matched_version.id = matched_scheme.current_version_id AND matched_version.version_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND matched_version.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND (matched_version.expiry_date IS NULL OR matched_version.expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE()) WHERE matched_scheme.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND matched_scheme.status = 1 AND matched_scheme.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_scheme_equipment matched_equipment WHERE matched_equipment.tenant_id = matched_version.tenant_id AND matched_equipment.scheme_version_id = matched_version.id AND matched_equipment.equipment_id = e.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applicable_categories matched_category WHERE matched_category.scheme_version_id = matched_version.id AND matched_category.id = e.category_id ) ) ) ) ORDER BY scheme.scheme_name, scheme.id

SELECT user.id AS user_id, user.username, user.real_name, CASE WHEN organization.organization_type = 'TEAM' THEN organization.organization_code END AS team_code FROM system_user user LEFT JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = user.tenant_id AND organization.id = user.organization_id AND organization.status = 1 AND organization.deleted = 0 WHERE user.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user.status = 1 AND user.deleted = 0 ORDER BY user.real_name, user.username, user.id LIMIT 500

SELECT organization_code AS team_code, organization_name AS team_name FROM organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_type = 'TEAM' AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY organization_name, id
